title: Chiral Perturbation Theory
note: PDF library/arxiv-hep-ph-9502366v1/ — arXiv:hep-ph/9502366v1, stamped 22 Feb 1995; report numbers FTUV/95-4 and IFIC/95-4; page 1 states 'To be published in Reports on Progress in Physics, February 1995'. The most usable review in this tranche for the chiral-limit question: the tree-level pseudoscalar masses are eq. (3.25), the Gell-Mann-Oakes-Renner relation eq. (3.27) and the current-algebra mass ratios eq. (3.28), all on PDF pp. 9-10; the O(p^4) corrections and the Gell-Mann-Okubo deviation are section 5.4, PDF p. 19, attributed there to Gasser and Leutwyler 1985 (= [gasser-leutwyler-1985] in this bibliography). Volume/pages of the published version not verified — omitted rather than guessed. Registered from library intake.
